id: \bStay out of our way.
en: \bStay out of our way.
it: \bTogliti di mezzo.

id: \rDawn: \PN, Brock, are you alright?
en: \rDawn: \PN, Brock, are you alright?
it: \rLucinda: \PN, Brock, state bene?

id: \bBrock: I'm fine. Did either of you hear a Pokémon's voice?
en: \bBrock: I'm fine. Did either of you hear a Pokémon's voice?
it: \bBrock: Io sto bene. Qualcuno di voi due ha sentito la voce di un Pokémon?

id: \rDawn: Yes. I think it was the lake guardians calling out to us for help. We need to stop Team Galactic before it's too late.
en: \rDawn: Yes. I think it was the lake guardians calling out to us for help. We need to stop Team Galactic before it's too late.
it: \rLucinda: Sì. Credo fossero i guardiani dei laghi che ci chiedevano aiuto. Dobbiamo fermare il Team Galassia prima che sia troppo tardi.

id: \bBrock: \PN, we'll take the grunts on. Hurry and stop the commanders.
en: \bBrock: \PN, we'll take the grunts on. Hurry and stop the commanders.
it: \bBrock: \PN, alle reclute pensiamo noi. Sbrigati a fermare i comandanti.

id: \bHold it.
en: \bHold it.
it: \bAlt.

id: \bTruth is, I don't know why I'm still here.
en: \bTruth is, I don't know why I'm still here.
it: \bA dire il vero, non so perché sono ancora qui.

id: \bLooker: Team Galactic is done for. But Dialga and Palkia are still an issue.
en: \bLooker: Team Galactic is done for. But Dialga and Palkia are still an issue.
it: \bBellocchio: Il Team Galassia è finito. Ma Dialga e Palkia sono ancora un problema.

id: \bStop.
en: \bStop.
it: \bFermo.

id: \bYou won't make it.
en: \bYou won't make it.
it: \bNon ce la farai.

id: \bHow are so many people here?
en: \bHow are so many people here?
it: \bCome fa a esserci così tanta gente qui?

id: \bSomeone will take my place.
en: \bSomeone will take my place.
it: \bQualcuno prenderà il mio posto.

id: \rCynthia: We need to subdue Dialga and Palkia.
en: \rCynthia: We need to subdue Dialga and Palkia.
it: \rCamilla: Dobbiamo placare Dialga e Palkia.

id: \bBrock: Find the ones in charge.
en: \bBrock: Find the ones in charge.
it: \bBrock: Trova i capi.

id: \bOur boss needs more time.
en: \bOur boss needs more time.
it: \bIl nostro capo ha bisogno di più tempo.

id: \bTeam Galactic will succeed.
en: \bTeam Galactic will succeed.
it: \bIl Team Galassia avrà successo.

id: \bSaturn: Again and again we run into each other. That stops today.
en: \bSaturn: Again and again we run into each other.  That stops today.
it: \bSaturno: Ci incontriamo di continuo.  Oggi questa storia finisce.

id: \bSaturn: Cyrus went into the portal. Will our new world begin?
en: \bSaturn: Cyrus went into the portal. Will our new world begin?
it: \bSaturno: Cyrus è entrato nel portale. Il nostro nuovo mondo avrà inizio?

id: \rJupiter: Our boss has already started the process. You'll never stop him.
en: \rJupiter: Our boss has already started the process.  You'll never stop him.
it: \rGiove: Il nostro capo ha già avviato il processo.  Non lo fermerai mai.

id: \rJupiter: Cyrus won't be bothered by someone like you.
en: \rJupiter: Cyrus won't be bothered by someone like you.
it: \rGiove: Cyrus non si farà disturbare da una nullità come te.

id: \rCynthia: You've done it. The Pokémon have gone back to their own dimensions.
en: \rCynthia: You've done it. The Pokémon have gone back to their own dimensions.
it: \rCamilla: Ce l'hai fatta. I Pokémon sono tornati nelle loro dimensioni.

id: \bLooker: Yes, and Team Galactic has been defeated. I wonder what happened to their leader, Cyrus? He disappeared into the portal made by the legendaries.
en: \bLooker: Yes, and Team Galactic has been defeated.  I wonder what happened to their leader, Cyrus? He disappeared into the portal made by the legendaries.
it: \bBellocchio: Sì, e il Team Galassia è stato sconfitto.  Chissà cosa ne è stato del loro capo, Cyrus? È sparito nel portale aperto dai leggendari.

id: \bWe can worry about that later. I'll handle arresting everyone. Cynthia, could you escort the children to safety?
en: \bWe can worry about that later. I'll handle arresting everyone. Cynthia, could you escort the children to safety?
it: \bCi penseremo più tardi. Agli arresti penso io. Camilla, potresti accompagnare i ragazzi al sicuro?

id: \rI would be happy to. \PN, let's go.
en: \rI would be happy to. \PN, let's go.
it: \rCon piacere. \PN, andiamo.

id: \rMars: You again? How many times are you going to get in our way?
en: \rMars: You again? How many times are you going to get in our way?
it: \rMartes: Ancora tu? Quante altre volte ci metterai i bastoni tra le ruote?

id: \rMars: Boss Cyrus will create a new world.
en: \rMars: Boss Cyrus will create a new world.
it: \rMartes: Il capo Cyrus creerà un nuovo mondo.

id: \rDawn: No need to worry.
en: \rDawn: No need to worry.
it: \rLucinda: Non c'è da preoccuparsi.
